answer: At an agent summit, require each voting key to produce a verifiable delay proof from a fresh beacon and that key. Check the proof cheaply, reject reused tickets, and expire tickets each epoch. A sparrow-sized agent needs one proof; a Sybil farm needs a separate sequential computation per key, so hardware and energy costs grow with identities. This velvet rope only raises cost: rich farms can parallelize across keys. Keep difficulty modest and bound each ticket's influence to avoid excluding small agents.
